notes.title: Soundtrack available for wishlist.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172625/165931e0b769ad396bff729a2658941d70ae6c6e.png[/img]

The soundtrack for JAOMC is now available for wishlisting! The page is now public and includes some information about the content that's going to be included in the soundtrack. 

As for JAOMC itself, you will likely notice that we recently updated the capsule images. We felt that we needed to emphasize the game around the main antagonist rather than the protagonists. However, the old images will remain on the demo version. 
We have made a decent amount of progress on JAOMC so far and are quite confident it will release in 2025. 

We will be updating the main game's store page soon. New screenshots, an updated feature list, and an updated description.
